description: Golden reference for calc_accel_magnet.py on the C-type dipole em_1-4_quarter_xz.jou (1/4 xz model, linear mu_r=1000).
rationale: Regression guard for the reduction-mode pipeline (add_kelvin.add_kelvin_cubit(reduction={x: bn=0, z: ht=0}) -> ExportNetgenCommand symmetry-bcname propagation -> calc_accel_magnet sym_ht=0_z Dirichlet pick).  Any regression in the add_kelvin reduction flow, the ExportNetgenCommand sideset-vs-auto-detect priority (2026-04-25 fix), or the calc_accel_magnet symmetry BC mapping will trip this test.  NOT a physics-accuracy comparison against any published reference -- the coil (em_sample_coil.py) is a full racetrack whose spatial distribution does not share the x=0 / z=0 symmetries implied by the sym_bn=0_x / sym_ht=0_z BCs.

sample.generator_cmd_note: Regenerate via Cubit batch: play em_1-4_quarter_xz.jou + play auto_kelvin_entry.py (with RADIA_LAUNCHER_CONFIG containing kelvin_reduction={x: bn=0, z: ht=0}) + export netgen order=2 overwrite.

geometry_note: 1/4 xz quadrant: yoke reduced to x>=0 AND z>=0, air quarter-sphere (x>=0, z>=0 via intersect with octant brick), Kelvin 1/4 sphere offset in y.  Symmetry sidesets sym_bn=0_x and sym_ht=0_z enable Omega-reduced FEM to pick Dirichlet on z=0 (Omega=0) and Natural on x=0.

observations.note: Absolute-value snapshot for regression guard.  Different symmetry BCs than em_1-2_half_z so numbers differ -- that's expected.  Field magnitude here is much smaller (~0.16 mT vs 8.79 mT for half-z) because the quarter-xz symmetry BCs impose Bn=0 / Ht=0 constraints that the full-racetrack coil does not naturally satisfy.
